parameters.jsCode: const r=$json||{},h=r.headers||{},b=r.body&&typeof r.body==='object'?r.body:r; const token=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); if(!$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN||token!==$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN) throw new Error('unauthorized'); const crypto=require('crypto'); const trace_id=String(b.trace_id||crypto.randomUUID()); const realm=String(b.realm||$env.N8N_REALM||$env.N8N_ENV_REALM||'aiops'); const request=String(b.request||b.text||'').trim(); if(!request) throw new Error('request is required'); const origin=String(r.webhookUrl||'').replace(/\/webhook\/.*$/,''); return [{json:{trace_id,realm,request,ingest_url:origin+'/webhook/ingest/webhook'}}];

parameters.query: INSERT INTO aiops_execution_events(trace_id,phase,status,message,metadata) VALUES ('{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','accepted','completed','要求を受け付けました',jsonb_build_object('realm','{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}')) RETURNING event_id, trace_id, '{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS realm, '{{ String($json.request).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS request, '{{ String($json.ingest_url).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS ingest_url;

INSERT INTO aiops_execution_events(trace_id,phase,status,message,metadata) VALUES ('{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','collecting_context','running','関連情報を収集しています',jsonb_build_object('realm','{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}')),('{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}','planning','pending','AIが対応案を作成します','{}'::jsonb) RETURNING event_id, trace_id, '{{ String($json.realm).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS realm, '{{ String($json.request).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS request, '{{ String($json.ingest_url).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS ingest_url;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json||{},h=r.headers||{},q=r.query||{}; const token=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); if(!$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN||token!==$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN) throw new Error('unauthorized'); const trace_id=String(q.trace_id||'').trim(); if(!trace_id) throw new Error('trace_id is required'); return [{json:{trace_id,after:Math.max(0,Number(q.after||0)||0)}}];

parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.event_id),'[]'::jsonb) AS events FROM (SELECT event_id,trace_id,job_id,phase,status,message,metadata,created_at FROM aiops_execution_events WHERE trace_id='{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AND event_id>{{ Number($json.after)||0 }} ORDER BY event_id ASC LIMIT 200) e;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$json||{},h=r.headers||{},q=r.query||{}; const token=String(h.authorization||h.Authorization||'').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''); if(!$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN||token!==$env.N8N_WORKFLOWS_TOKEN) throw new Error('unauthorized'); const trace_id=String(q.trace_id||'').trim(); if(!trace_id) throw new Error('trace_id is required'); return [{json:{trace_id}}];

parameters.query: SELECT q.job_id,q.status,q.started_at,q.finished_at,q.result_payload,q.error_payload FROM (VALUES (1)) seed(n) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT jq.job_id,jq.status,jq.started_at,jq.finished_at,jr.result_payload,jr.error_payload FROM aiops_job_queue jq LEFT JOIN aiops_job_results jr ON jr.job_id=jq.job_id WHERE jq.trace_id='{{ String($json.trace_id).replace(/'/g, "''") }}' ORDER BY jq.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) q ON true;
